draft.title: Coaching
card: the way a coach leads and makes decisions. An autocratic coach decides alone and gives orders. A democratic coach asks athletes for input and shares some decisions.
a good training program fits the athletes' age, skill and fitness. It builds up gradually and includes rest, so athletes improve and are less likely to be injured.

an ethical coach is fair, honest and respectful, and puts athletes' wellbeing before winning. With young athletes, this means keeping training safe, avoiding bullying and not pushing them to play through injury.
Style, program and behaviour all affect whether athletes enjoy a sport, stay in it and perform well.
draft.remember: Coaching shapes participation and performance through how a coach leads, plans training and behaves.

a.q: Which action shows ethical coaching of a junior team?
opts: Resting a player with a sore ankle, even in a final
Playing the best players for the whole game to win
Making players who lose a game do extra laps
Choosing the team without telling players why
a.why: An ethical coach puts wellbeing before winning, so resting an injured player is right even in a final. Playing the best players for the whole game is tempting because it helps the team win, but it ignores fairness to the rest of the squad.
a.clue: Which choice puts the athlete's wellbeing before winning?

b.q: Coach Priya in Geelong lets her under-14 netball team vote on training drills and match positions. Which coaching style is this, and what is a likely effect?
opts: Democratic, and players may feel more involved
Autocratic, and players may feel more involved
Democratic, and players may feel they have no say
Autocratic, and players may feel they have no say
b.why: Priya shares decisions with her players, so her style is democratic. Having a say can make players feel more involved, which may help them stay in the sport. An autocratic coach would decide alone.
b.clue: Who makes the decisions in this team?

a.best: Resting a player with a sore ankle, even in a final

b.best: Democratic, and players may feel more involved
